  - **Decided (19:02, coordinator, owner-delegated):** (1) Settings' trailing controls follow Density's title-line alignment: a control on the title line stays put as the width rewraps the description, so the trailing column keeps one steady line, where a centred control drifts down with each wrapped line. (2) A control taller than the view is revealed by its leading edge in both passes: the passes agree, so the scroll cannot swing, and the leading edge holds the label and first action. (3) A focus restore whose control is covered by Settings or a dialog leaves focus where it is and keeps the control as the covered page's return target: focus behind a modal is invisible and takes the next key. (4) Markdown images: declared dimensions refuse an image before decoding, the post-decode check stays as the backstop (a header can lie). (5) `cut_word` cuts on extended grapheme clusters; `unicode-segmentation` is already a direct dependency, so FU8-G N-c needs no new crate.

- Evidence method that held, now tracked as `python3 scripts/native_qa/qa.py` ([README](../../scripts/native_qa/README.md)): `launch` runs the app under XWayland (`DISPLAY=:1`, `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` unset, `GPUI_X11_SCALE_FACTOR=1`) with a fresh absolute `HOME`/`XDG_*`, an empty run directory, a `GitTurtle QA <qa@example.invalid>` `.gitconfig` and fixtures under `/tmp/gitturtle-evidence/`, finds its window by `_NET_WM_PID` and stops it with SIGTERM only; `compare` (masked base-versus-candidate frames), `privacy scan`, `identity` (sha256 and `--build-info`; a base built into the candidate's target directory once made the candidate build a no-op) and `display-check` (`pgrep` and `date -u`, run by the coordinator before each handover) cover the rest. On 2026-09-25 it reproduced the committed `button-states/midnight-1000x680-rows-button-hover.png` byte for byte, and a Midnight History frame matched its reference apart from the timing digits. The evidence a visible change needs, in a light and a full tier, is in [visual evidence tiers](../../.agents/skills/gitturtle-native-qa/references/visual-evidence.md). The FileChooser portal dialogs are Wayland clients: capture them with Mutter ScreenCast `RecordArea`, and type into them through Mutter RemoteDesktop only while a widget inside the dialog has focus. For AT-SPI, set `org.a11y.Status IsEnabled` true for one launch, then restore it and read it back; with it off the app never registers.
- Commands: `python3 scripts/gate.py fast` (or `full`); `cargo test --locked --workspace`; `umask 022 && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/agent_loop -t scripts -p 'test_*.py'`; `python3 scripts/check-agent-guidance.py`.
- Known issues: a new macOS-only GPUI view-test flake most likely has one of #48's two causes: a reply from a real `SerialExecutor` thread that `run_until_parked` does not wait for (drain it with the test-only `SerialExecutor::drain()`), or a dialog's wall-clock animation (open it with reduced motion). Keep other builds off the host while a gate runs. The `gh` HTTPS token lacks the `workflow` scope, so a push that changes `.github/workflows/` is refused: push over SSH (`git push git@github.com:FernandoX7/GitTurtle.git <branch>`). In the agent-loop controller, a `blocked` status does not keep a task out of selection; hold a task by setting `attempts` to `max_attempts` and restore it later. A failed gate replaces the coordinator note and starts the next attempt at once. Background agents can hang on an `rm` with a glob, so delete with Python. Subagents cannot write report files, so they return findings as text, and a `SendMessage` to a busy background subagent is read only when its turn ends, so put every decision in the brief. Two traps from 2026-09-28 on the Pop!_OS host: another window took X focus during a QA run (17:02 to 17:05 UTC), so QA keys now go through the drivers' focus-checked sender; and two worktrees built into one `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` gave different commits an identical binary, so give each candidate its own target directory and check `--build-info`.
